narrative.overview:
Vista's visual language treats Zamboanga beach resort booking with the composure of a print coastal monograph and the immediacy of a live availability ledger. Rather than floating translucent glass cards over busy backgrounds, every guest-facing screen alternates between sun-warmed coral limestone paper and deep twilight sea contrast bands, letting full-bleed photography, crisp hairline dividers, and monumental serif typography carry the atmosphere while prices, capacities, and dates remain effortlessly scannable on phones.

The system is intentionally flat and architectural. Surfaces sit directly on the page plane, separated by thin maritime-ink rules and disciplined vertical pacing rather than drop shadows or rounded pill chrome. Across guest-facing surfaces—homepage, resort directory, per-resort landing pages, stay details, and checkout—this Folio identity governs every typographic, chromatic, and structural choice. The staff and admin operations desk remains a flat, high-density operational workspace focused on tables, calendars, and payment verification speed, sharing the same discipline of crisp contrast, zero frosted-glass bloat, and restrained color.

Legacy frosted-glass blur panels, soft ambient glow orbs, gradient headline text, and eyebrow/kicker labels above headings are explicitly retired.
keyCharacteristics: Sun-warmed coral limestone ground paired with deep Zamboanga twilight sea contrast bands (60-30-10 pacing).
Monumental Cormorant Garamond display headlines anchored by crisp Instrument Sans controls, rates, and tabular figures.
Rectilinear architectural framing (0px on plates and cards, 3px on buttons, 4px on floating finder bars) divided by 1px hairlines.
Strict flat-by-default surfaces with shadow reserved solely for floating hero search or checkout bars over photography.
High-contrast accessibility across both light paper (>=6.1:1) and deep-water dark bands (>=9.1:1), with zero fabricated metrics or decorative ornament.

rules.name: The 60-30-10 Coastal Pacing Rule
rules.body: Sixty percent of every guest page lives on sunlit coral limestone and architectural white; thirty percent anchors the rhythm in full-bleed twilight abyss bands and deep ink; terracotta-ochre, reef teal, and travertine gold stay within ten percent so every action and price reads instantaneously.

rules.name: The Dark-Band Gold Rule
rules.body: Travertine gold (#e8a85a) and travertine pale (#f4d6a8) never appear as text or icons on light limestone or white surfaces—they are reserved exclusively for deep twilight abyss (#071926) grounds and dark photography.

rules.name: The Light-Surface Teal Floor
rules.body: Interactive links and starting prices on light surfaces always use Reef Teal (#065a6b) or Editorial Ink (#091b28), never lighter coastal teals that drop below WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

rules.name: The Zero-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place an uppercase tracked kicker, pill badge, or small label above a display or section heading. Place location metadata (City, Barangay) and resort attributions directly beneath the heading in sentence case.

rules.name: The Single-Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve Cormorant Garamond italics (400 weight) for one concluding phrase inside dark-band display headlines (open for your date., without the inbox wait., beach day.) so emphasis stays unmistakable and never clutters body text.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every peso rate, guest count, room/cottage inventory figure, and rating average sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numbers align cleanly across grids and index rows.

rules.name: The Shared 1200px Rail Rule
rules.body: Navigation, content bands, and footer always share the exact same 1200px inner container and 28px (18px mobile) outer gutters so the left wordmark and right action button lock vertically to every section edge below.

rules.name: The Zero-Orphan Directory Rule
rules.body: Never render an unbalanced trailing row of 1 or 2 cards beneath a 3-column grid. Promote one lead item to a full-width horizontal spread, fill a complete 3-column folio row, and list remaining items in a compact horizontal index below.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface on limestone or deep-water grounds is completely flat (box-shadow: none, backdrop-filter: none). Elevation shadows appear only when an interactive white bar floats directly across full-bleed photography.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Decorative backdrop-filter: blur() panels are prohibited on guest surfaces and cards. Overlays over photography use directional linear dark-water scrims (rgba(7, 25, 38, 0.88) fading to 0.28 on desktop; uniform 0.76->0.90 vertical scrim on phones) for guaranteed legibility.

rules.name: The Sharp-Plate, Crisp-Control Rule
rules.body: Structural surfaces and imagery stay square (0px), interactive controls soften just to 3px (4px on floating search bars), and oversized 16px+ pill radii are avoided.

dos: Do alternate sunlit Coral Limestone (#f7f3ec) bands with full-bleed Twilight Abyss (#071926) bands to maintain the 60-30-10 magazine rhythm across guest pages.
Do lock every header, content band, and footer to the shared 1200px container (28px desktop / 18px mobile gutters).
Do place City, Barangay location sub-lines and resort attributions directly below headings in sentence case, reserving full street addresses for inside resort pages and booking confirmations.
Do use drawn inline SVG icons for stars, arrows, and UI glyphs, and set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every price, inventory count, and rating.
Do enforce >=44px touch heights on all buttons, tabs, and action links, and apply 2px solid #e8a85a :focus-visible outlines on every dark band.
Do render live database values (archived_at IS NULL) directly at full opacity on load—never hide below-the-fold sections behind scroll-gated opacity: 0 traps.
donts: Don't place uppercase tracked eyebrows, kickers, or glowing-dot pill badges above headings.
Don't apply backdrop-filter: blur(), drop shadows on resting cards, gradient headline text, ambient glow blobs, or one-sided accent border bars.
Don't put Travertine Gold (#e8a85a) text or icons on light limestone or white backgrounds, or low-contrast mid-teals on light surfaces.
Don't add meaningless decorative sequence numbers (02, 03, 04) to unranked cards, or fabricate customer counts, booking-time guarantees, press logos, or awards beyond resort_db.
Don't allow nested bordered inputs inside paned search/checkout bars—always scope borderless input rules specifically enough to clear global input borders.
Don't split guest count into separate Adults and Children fields on availability or booking forms—always use one total Guests field.
